Hantavirus is carried naturally by rodents, mainly rats, and human infection occurs primarily through inhalation of dust contaminated with dried rat urine or feces. Transmission from person to person is not possible according to the official statement; rodent bites can also transmit the virus, though this is reported as rare. Early symptoms include high fever, chills, headache, muscle pain, and extreme fatigue; two main clinical manifestations require monitoring. To mitigate risk, facilities at primary and referral health centers are stocked with medicines, and the public is urged to practice clean living habits, frequent soap-based handwashing, and keep homes rodent-free.

triage.headline_ja: 家のネズミを侮るな、ソロ保健局がハンタウイルス脅威に対応を開始
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで予防的警戒が始まっており、複数州からの報告が背景にあるが、ソロ市での確認症例はなく、社会的関心も国際的拡大リスクも現時点では限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではインドネシア（ソロ市）で確認症例がないため「突然」感染症危機でなく予防的警戒段階である。複数州での報告があるが詳細不明。齧歯動物媒介でヒト・ヒト感染なし。ハンタウイルスはWPRO地域で流行性があり、長期的曝露リスク（ネズミ駆除）と管理可能性が評価対象。フルRRA前の続報待ちが適切。

article.articleHeadline: Chinese health experts move to calm fears of virus spread
article.articleSummary: Andes hantavirus outbreak on MV Hondius (Netherlands-flag) that departed Ushuaia (Argentina, Tierra del Fuego) around April 1; first symptoms around April 6. Three deaths reported so far. The virus causes heart and lung problems with fatality 35-50%; human-to-human transmission after prolonged close contact is limited; the natural host (long-tailed pygmy mouse) is not present in China, reducing large-scale domestic spread. Diagnosis features fever, proteinuria, and thrombocytopenia; early ICU admission and ECMO recommended for severe cases. Exposure likely occurred in Argentina or Patagonia before boarding; ongoing outbreak on cruise ship with potential secondary cases monitored to assess sustained transmission. Forum by Chinese Medical Association gathered 2,500 participants and 11,000 views; emphasizes rapid clinical identification and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の保健専門家がウイルス拡散への懸念を鎮静化させるため動く
triage.triage_reason: アンデスハンタウイルスの国際的なクルーズ船集団発生で、死亡事例（3名）と高い致死率（35-50%）が報告されている。中国が関連性を持つことで、社会的・政治的関心が高まっており、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ）に該当。
triage.notes: アンデスハンタウイルスはアルゼンチンで発生しており、対象国リストではアルゼンチンは含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ただし記事が中国の衛生専門家による対応フォーラム（2,500参加者、11,000ビュー）を報告していることから、中国の社会的・政治的関心が高く、Chinaを対象に含めた。国際的なクルーズ船関連の集団発生であり、中国への輸入リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Virus, il marittimo calabrese in quarantena: io "primo malato d'Italia" per un equivoco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Virus, the Calabrian sailor in quarantine: I am 'Italy's first patient' due to a misunderstanding.
article.articleSummary: Federico Amaretti, a 25-year-old Italian navigation officer from Villa San Giovanni, Calabria, was briefly misidentified as Italy’s first hantavirus patient. The Calabrian sailor, employed by Grimaldi Lines, had just returned from a long car-transport voyage—from China to South Africa—when he flew on April 25 from Johannesburg to Amsterdam, en route to Italy. A coincidental link emerged with Mirjam Schilperoord, wife of a Dutch ornithologist who died from hantavirus on the Mv Hondius in Ushuaia, Argentina, but no direct contact or illness was reported. Health authorities later traced Amaretti and others on the flight, placing them in precautionary quarantine. Public reports of a hospitalization, cough, and fever were false, and Villa San Giovanni’s mayor Giusy Caminiti clarified that Amaretti was asymptomatic and not admitted to Spallanzani. He remains isolated at home with strict no-contact rules, temperature checks twice daily, and meals left at his door, while his family members stay on the upper floor. The situation underscores misinformation alongside containment measures in May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス、カラブリア州の船員が隔離中：誤解による「イタリア初のハンタウイルス患者」
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染の可能性があるが、実際の患者は確認されておらず、記事の主題は誤認識と予防的隔離措置である。今後の展開を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本イベントは対象国（CEPR対象地域）での実際の感染症発生ではなく、国際線の乗客との接触に基づく予防的隔離の報告である。患者は無症状であり、誤った報道が主な懸念。記事の地理的言及（China、South Africa、Argentina、Netherlands、Italy）は対象国に含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列。

article.articleHeadline: Quảng Ninh: Hỗ trợ nông dân 'vượt khó' sau dịch tả lợn châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quảng Ninh: Supporting farmers to weather the difficulties after the African swine fever outbreak
article.articleSummary: In Quảng Ninh Province's Van Đồn District, 14 African swine fever (ASF) outbreaks were detected in 14 farming households from Feb 13, 2026, with 221 pigs culled (live weight >20.3 tonnes). All culled animals tested positive for ASF; outbreaks were declared and culling, environmental decontamination (lime powder, disinfection), and warning signage implemented. Farmers adhered to reporting, sanitation, movement restrictions, and vaccination per local plans. A 12 May 2026 evaluation panel found all 14 households eligible for support under Decree 116/2025, at 40,000 VND per kg of live-weight culled, totaling over 812 million VND from the Van Đồn district budget. The panel recommended approval by the Van Đồn Special Zone People’s Committee. Deputy Chairman Đào Văn Vũ urged timely, transparent compensation to stabilize production and restore husbandry, with monitoring of repopulation and ongoing outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: クアンニン省：アフリカ豚コレラの流行後、農民の困難克服を支援
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラは動物疾患であり、記事の焦点は畜産被害と農民補償である。ヒト-ヒト感染リスクは無く、国際的拡大リスクは評価困難だが、動物衛生の既知の流行地域での事例対応として社会的・政治的関心がある。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本イベントはアフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）で、ヒト感染リスクなし。動物疾患であるため公衆衛生上のIHR基準には該当しない。ただしWPRO基準では重症度（221頭の豚が殺処分）・持続的曝露（14農家での同時期の多発）・流行易易性（ASFの伝播可能性）で3基準該当。ベトナムは対象国であり、政府レベルの支援対応が記載されている。動物疾患シグナルのため継続監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: IDAI Sebut Campak Lebih Mendesak Dibanding Hantavirus : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: IDAI Says Measles Are More Urgent Than Hantavirus: Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: Jakarta-based Indonesian Pediatric Society (IDAI) states measles (campak) and diphtheria (difteri) are more urgent than hantavirus in Indonesia due to ongoing cases and suboptimal control across multiple regions. Prof. Dr. Dominicus Husada of IDAI notes measles has resurged over the past 2–3 years and remains unresolved, while diphtheria has persisted for years. He emphasizes that the burden of measles, diphtheria, tetanus, and pertussis is considerably higher than hantavirus, which is relatively rare in the country. The call centers on preventive measures, as many Indonesians are not adequately protected. The remarks were made in Jakarta, highlighting that public health priorities should focus on controlling more prevalent infectious diseases with sustained transmission rather than hantavirus.

triage.headline_ja: IDAI ハンタウイルスより麻しんの方がより緊急と述べる：Okezone Women
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおいて麻しん、ジフテリア、百日咳、破傷風が流行している状況について、公衆衛生機関（IDAI）が重大性を指摘。複数地域での継続的な症例報告と制御不十分の状況が確認され、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）の複数基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアの公衆衛生専門家による麻しん、ジフテリア、百日咳、破傷風の流行に関する警告を報告している。過去2〜3年間の麻しんの再流行、ジフテリアの数年にわたる持続、および制御不十分な状況が記述されている。ハンタウイルスは比較的稀で優先度が低いと位置付けられている。複数の地域での症例報告と継続的な伝播が確認されるため、シグナルとして識別される。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Hantavirus, Kemenkes Awasi Ketat Penumpang Amerika Selatan Selama 46 Hari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus Alert: Health Ministry to Closely Monitor South American Passengers for 46 Days
article.articleSummary: Indonesia tightens surveillance on international travelers, particularly those from South America, following concerns about Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS) linked to the cruise ship MV Hondius. The Health Ministry says Argentina and other parts of South America are of particular concern due to HPS cases. Acting Director-General Andi Saguni said Indonesia uses the All Indonesia digital system to trace travelers’ histories, including transit stops, to identify those arriving from risk regions. The heightened alert centers on the 46-day incubation window reported for the Hondius-associated HPS variant. With this long incubation, authorities will conduct intensive monitoring of passengers from risk areas over the coming weeks. The government stresses that there is no mass quarantine policy like during COVID-19.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス警戒：保健省が南米からの乗客を46日間厳密に監視
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるハンタウイルス肺症候群(HPS)の監視体制強化は異常・予想外であり、スクリーニング基準を複数満たすが、確定症例がインドネシア国内に報告されていないため、WATCH段階での経過観察を推奨。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはアルゼンチン発の巡航船MV Hondiusでのハンタウイルス事例に関連し、インドネシアが南米からの乗客に対して監視を強化していることを述べている。IHR基準を3つ満たし、WPRO基準も4つ満たすが、インドネシア国内での確定症例報告がなく、監視対象段階であるため、WATCH判定とした。デルタ地域への動向について続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 6-month-old child with measles symptoms dies at Cumilla Medical
article.articleSummary: Six-month-old Rabbi, son of Kausar Ahmed from Gurgaon area of Sadar South Upazila, died in the measles isolation unit at Cumilla Medical College Hospital (CuMCH) early Wednesday morning, May 13, after admission on May 9 with measles. At least seven children have died from measles or measles symptoms in Cumilla, with four fatalities occurring at CuMCH. Sixty-nine children are currently admitted to CuMCH’s measles isolation unit. District-wide, the civil surgeon reports about 1,500 people with measles or symptoms, of which 100 are confirmed measles. To date, 1,078 patients have been hospitalised in the district, 933 have recovered, and 145 remain hospitalised. The figures indicate an active measles outbreak in Cumilla, with sustained hospitalisation and isolation measures.

triage.headline_ja: クミラ医科大学で麻疹症状の6ヶ月児が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の集団発生による複数の死亡と大規模な入院が報告されており、IHR基準3項目（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。スクリーニング基準でも重症度と長期曝露が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでCumullaはバングラデシュの地名と明示。Gurgaonはインド（ハリヤナ州）であるが、死亡したRabbiはGurgaon出身だが死亡地はCumullaであり、実際の発生地はバングラデシュのCumilla。スクリーニング基準全5項目が該当し、高度なアラート必要。

article.articleHeadline: 上海启动滚动式灭蚊 严防蚊媒传染病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shanghai launches a rolling mosquito-control campaign to strictly prevent mosquito-borne infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: Shanghai launches a rolling citywide mosquito-control campaign from mid-May to November to prevent dengue fever and chikungunya in Shanghai, China. The first round starts May 18, with rounds every 10–14 days and each lasting at least 3 days. The program centers on four measures: routine environmental sanitation, upgraded vector-control capacity, strengthened primary responsibility among government departments, and a citizen hotline for oversight. It will follow the 2026 Shanghai Aedes albopictus Prevention and Control Guidelines, integrating environmental management, physical control, chemical disinfection, and health education. Two enforcement inspections are planned for July and September to coincide with mosquito-density peaks and major events. Global dengue and chikungunya activity and warmer springs with higher rainfall since April raise importation and local transmission risk via imported cases. Shanghai will mobilize volunteers, third-party assessments, and information systems to identify breeding sites and monitor adult-mosquito surges.

triage.headline_ja: 上海が蚊媒介感染症の厳格な予防のためのローリング式蚊対策キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: デング熱とチクングニアの輸入リスク増加に対応した予防的キャンペーンの報道。現在の発症報告はないが、蚊媒介感染症の国際的活動が高く、上海での輸入例及び局所感染のリスクが認識されている。IHR基準は現時点では明確に該当しないが、スクリーニング基準（異常性・流行しやすさ）に部分的に該当し、今後の発症状況追跡が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既存の発症例報告ではなく、予防的な蚊対策キャンペーンの立ち上げについての報道である。ただし、グローバルなデング熱・チクングニア活動と4月以降の気温上昇・降雨増加による輸入リスク及び局所伝播リスクが明示されている。現時点ではシグナルとしてのピックアップは不要だが、上海での確定例報告が発生した場合は即座にPICKUPへの昇格が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus HIV di Kota Sorong capai 4.431 orang hingga April 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV cases in Sorong City have reached 4,431 people as of April 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of April 2026, HIV in Sorong City totals 4,431 cases, with 86 new cases from January–April 2026; cumulative 4,345 cases were recorded in 2024–2025. Women account for 1,865 cases and men for 1,381; HIV/AIDS deaths total 486. The age distribution peaks in productive ages, especially 20–29, then 30–39 and 40–49, with 314 cases in 15–19 years and some cases in 1–4 years. By marital status, 2,904 are married, 1,639 unmarried, 612 divorced. Education levels show 1,930 high school graduates, 952 junior high, 747 elementary, 487 college, and 249 with no schooling. Of the 86 new cases in 2026, 49 are from the general population; 6 MSM; 1 transgender woman; 6 female sex workers; 14 TB patients; 12 pregnant women; and 4 partners of HIV-positive individuals. About 831 people living with HIV/AIDS remain on antiretroviral therapy; authorities emphasize education, early detection, and treatment adherence to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ソロン市のHIV患者数が2026年4月時点で4,431人に到達
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・ソロン市における HIV/AIDS の累積症例報告であり、地域内での持続的な感染曝露と重症度（死亡 486 件）が認められるが、国内統計報告型の情報であり、国際的拡大リスクや顕著な社会的・政治的関心の高まりは記事から直接読み取れない。継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: ソロン市（Sorong）はインドネシア・パプア西州内の都市。記事は HIV 流行の定期的な統計報告であり、新規患者が持続的に発生している状況と、高い死亡率（486 件）が確認される。結核患者 14 件の HIV 重複感染も報告されている。ただし、異常や予想外の事象というより、既存の地方衛生当局による疾患監視報告であるため、IHR 基準は1つのみ該当。WPRO スクリーニング基準では「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行易すさ」に該当するが、記事から公衆衛生上の緊急対応が急速に必要な段階であるかは不明であり、経過観察段階と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Siaga Hantavirus, Penumpang 4 Negara Ini Diawasi Masuk Bandara Soetta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus Alert: Passengers From These Four Countries Are Being Monitored on Arrival at Soekarno-Hatta International Airport.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus alert in Indonesia as Quarantine Health Authority at Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (Soetta) tightens arrival screening for international travelers, following WHO reports of three cruise-ship fatalities from hantavirus. Passengers arriving from four American countries—United States, Argentina, Uruguay, and Panama—will undergo enhanced, multilayer monitoring, whether direct or via transit. Soetta’s BBKK has deployed early-detection systems, requiring travelers to complete the SATUSEHAT health declaration, undergo temperature checks and visual medical observation, with rapid referral to a quarantine physician if symptoms arise. An exclusive evacuation route and sterilized transfer facilities are prepared to minimize cross-contamination during handling. Hantavirus transmits primarily through contact with rodent urine, feces, or saliva and inhalation of virus-laden aerosols; not typically person-to-person. Authorities emphasize hygiene and strong immune defenses while maintaining vigilance for new cases impacting entry screening rules.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス警戒：これら4か国からの乗客がソエタ空港到着時に監視されている
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで国際的な到着スクリーニング強化が実施されており、WHO報告の船舶クルーズにおける死亡例があるため、異常/予想外の対応（スクリーニング基準1つ以上）に該当するが、インドネシア国内での実際の患者発生やアウトブレイクの明確な報告がないため情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はインドネシア（ソエタ空港）での到着スクリーニング強化であり、実際のインドネシア国内でのハンタウイルス患者発生の直接的な報告はない。WHOが報告した「3人の船舶クルーズ死亡者」は具体的な発生国が明記されておらず詳細不明。IHR基準は2つ以上該当するが、国内での実患者発生やアウトブレイク確認がないため、PICKUP判定には至らず、継続的な経過観察（WATCH）が適切と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Tangerang siagakan faskes untuk tangani temuan Hantavirus - ANTARA News Banten
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tangerang mobilizes health facilities to handle hantavirus detections - ANTARA News Banten
article.articleSummary: Three regional general hospitals (RSUDs) in Tangerang Regency, Banten Province, Indonesia, are on alert to handle potential hantavirus detections after the World Health Organization reported transmission to three cruise-ship passengers who died from the virus. As of May 13, 2026, no suspected or confirmed hantavirus cases have been reported in Tangerang. The Health Office (Dinas Kesehatan) has prepared facilities across three RSUDs and primary health centers (Puskesmas) for early management, with treatment described as supportive. Symptoms of hantavirus closely resemble influenza, complicating initial diagnosis. Preparedness follows COVID-19-style measures, emphasizing Healthy Living Behavior (PHBS), distancing, hand hygiene, and mask use when flu-like symptoms occur. If cases are identified, all hospitals and Puskesmas are ready to respond. Public health guidance urges residents to maintain PHBS to prevent rodent-borne transmission.

triage.headline_ja: タンゲラン、ハンタウイルス検出への対応で保健施設を警戒態勢に - ANTARA News バンテン
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（タンゲラン）で保健施設の警戒態勢が敷かれているハンタウイルス関連の報道だが、当地での確認症例は報告されておらず、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、タンゲラン（インドネシア）が検出対応の主要な場所として記載されている。ただし当地での確認症例がないため、スクリーニング基準は複数該当するものの、実際の発生確認による重症度・影響度の判定が困難。WHO報告による国際的な動きは言及されているが、タンゲラン地域での実際の患者発生は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes siagakan 51 Balai Karantina Kesehatan antisipasi hantavirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health deploys 51 Health Quarantine Offices to anticipate hantavirus.
article.articleSummary: As of May 13, 2026, Indonesia's Health Ministry has deployed 51 Quarantine Offices (BKK) nationwide to anticipate hantavirus transmission. Acting Director General Andi Saguni said the quarantine network prevents and counters infectious diseases from abroad by monitoring travelers from risk countries and observing possible cases. Entry screening uses thermal scanners and symptom checks; a digital barcode system replaces paper forms to compile entry-point data, and suspected cases are referred to designated hospitals. The move follows hantavirus concerns aboard the cruise MV Hondius, identified as Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS), which differs from Indonesia's hantavirus. HPS is mainly in South America and has not been reported in Indonesia, while Indonesia's hantavirus cases are hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) since 1991, caused by Seoul virus; there is currently no evidence of human-to-human transmission for HFRS in Asia/Indonesia. The Hondius case involves Andes virus, a strain with possible human transmission in close contact.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省が51の保健隔離事務所を配備しハンタウイルスに対応
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでハンタウイルス関連の予防対策が展開されており、国際的な輸送関連の懸念（MV Hondius船舶）があるが、インドネシア国内での確認症例がなく、実際の流行兆候が不明確。情報の充実を待つ必要がある。
triage.notes: インドネシア国内ではハンタウイルス性腎症候群（HFRS）は1991年以来確認されているが、MV Hondius船での確認はアンデスウイルス（南米型）であり、インドネシア国内での人-人感染の証拠はない。対応は予防的・先制的な措置であり、現時点での流行または重大な国内発症の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: O 'arsenal' secreto da salmonela: cientistas descobrem 45 novas toxinas da bactéria por trás das infecções alimentares
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The secret 'arsenal' of Salmonella: scientists discover 45 new toxins produced by the bacterium behind foodborne infections.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella, the bacterium behind foodborne infections, possesses a diverse toxin arsenal, according to researchers at the University of São Paulo (USP). Analyzing more than 6,000 Salmonella samples, the team identified 128 toxin types, 45 of which are entirely new or markedly different from known variants. Using the Type VI secretion system as a molecular syringe, Salmonella injects toxins into rival cells; some toxins target other bacteria, while others interact with fungi, algae, or mammalian cells. While some substances may play a direct role in human infections, laboratory confirmation is still required. The study found that natural isolates harbor more diverse toxin repertoires than patient-derived strains, likely reflecting environmental competition. This expanded map of toxins could inform future antibiotics, therapies, and biotechnological tools. The findings, published in PLOS Biology, underscore the ongoing food-safety risk posed by Salmonella.

triage.headline_ja: サルモネラ菌の'秘密兵器': 科学者が食中毒を引き起こす細菌が産生する45の新しい毒素を発見
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究レポート（サルモネラ毒素の新発見）であり、進行中の感染症アウトブレイクではない。具体的な患者数、死亡例、公衆衛生上の緊急事態の記述がなく、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はサルモネラ菌の毒性メカニズムに関する基礎研究成果（PLOS Biology掲載）であり、実際の患者発生やアウトブレイクを報告していない。Bluedot APIが地域として Brazil を検出しているのは、研究機関（São Paulo 大学）の所在地に基づくもので、実際の感染症イベント発生地ではない。そのため verified_locations は空配列とする。

article.articleHeadline: Hand, foot and mouth disease, dengue cases spike in Vietnam's Ho Chi Minh City
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, records a spike in HFMD and dengue in early 2026. HFMD: four-month report (May 11) shows April with 5,243 inpatient/outpatient cases, up 163.6% from March and over 109% higher than 2025; Jan–Apr total 12,063 cases, +164% YoY, with five deaths. By May 3, cumulative HFMD infections reached 15,104. High-incidence areas per 100,000: Con Dao Special Zone, Bình Khánh Commune, Long Điền Commune. Dengue: Jan–mid-April 13,738 cases, +71% YoY; by May 3, 15,935 cases and one death. Measles 168 cases, Covid-19 18 cases, Mpox 1 case; no deaths from these. Meningococcal efforts include training and expanded immunisation plans for 2026–2028. Severe dengue case: a 10-year-old girl from Dong Thap Province with dengue shock syndrome and haemophagocytic syndrome; ferritin near 50,000 µg/L, liver/kidney involvement; after intensive treatment she stabilised and is to be discharged. Authorities urge early care for fever lasting 2–3 days with abdominal pain, vomiting, or bleeding during dengue season.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのホーチミン市で手足口病とデング熱の患者が急増
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症（HFMD、デング熱）でホーチミン市において前年比100%以上の顕著な増加が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）を満たす。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明確に述べられているホーチミン市での複数感染症の同時発生は、2026年初期の著しい流行を示唆している。HFMD：4月に前月比163.6%増、前年比109%増；デング熱：1月〜4月中旬で前年比71%増。5月3日時点で累積HFMD 15,104件、デング熱 15,935件に達しており、デング熱では死亡例1件、HFMD死亡5件が報告されている。小児重症デング熱（デング出血熱とHPS）の症例報告もあり、医療負荷が増加している可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Người đàn ông tử vong vì bệnh dại vẫn chưa rõ nguồn lây nhiễm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man dies of rabies; source of infection remains unclear.
article.articleSummary: As of May 13, 2026, Dong Nai CDC reports a rabies death—the second in the city for 2026. The patient, a 72-year-old man (Đ.V.T.), a resident of Bom Bo commune, developed initial symptoms on April 23 (chest pain, shortness of breath, dizziness, poor appetite) and a day later exhibited hydrophobia, aerophobia, photophobia, and dysphagia. He was transferred to Ho Chi Minh City’s Tropical Disease Hospital for treatment. On May 3 his condition worsened; on May 7 his family requested discharge, and he died the following morning. RT-PCR on saliva confirmed rabies virus. No exposure event was reported by family; he did not recall bites, scratches, or licks from dogs or cats, though he farms about 500 meters from home and two dogs in the household were healthy. The infection source remains unidentified, complicating containment; authorities urge vaccination after potential exposure, especially during seasonal transitions.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病で男性が死亡、感染源は依然不明
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の死亡事例で異常性と重症度基準を満たすが、情報不足（感染源未特定、1事例）により、WPRO基準の管理可能性が判断できない。続報を要注視。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率が高く（重症度基準満たす）、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクは低いが、動物由来感染症で管理可能性や感染源特定が不確実。2026年Ho Chi Minh市内2番目の死亡事例。感染源未特定のため、封じ込めが困難であり、当局が予防接種を呼びかけている点は管理可能性の懸念を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Есть ли вероятность распространения хантавируса в Узбекистане  --  ответ Минздрава
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is there a risk of hantavirus spreading in Uzbekistan — Ministry of Health's response.
article.articleSummary: Uzbekistan reports no hantavirus cases; epidemiological situation is stable. There are more than 20 hantavirus types, but only some infect humans; the virus is most commonly found in Latin America (Argentina, Chile, Brazil), with far fewer detections in Asia and Europe. Preventive measures include personal hygiene, safe food storage, regular ventilation, and careful cleaning of rodent-infested areas. A total of 53 border crossing points have permanent sanitary-epidemiological control to prevent importation of dangerous infections. Hantavirus, carried by house mice and voles, can cause severe lung or kidney disease and death in some cases; primary transmission is airborne. Early symptoms resemble flu, delaying diagnosis. International context: the Dutch cruise MV Hondius reported a hantavirus outbreak with three deaths after traveling from Argentina to Cabo Verde; Canary Islands passengers were evacuated. The WHO later confirmed 11 cases, with nine attributed to Andes virus.

triage.headline_ja: ウズベキスタンでハンタウイルスが流行する可能性があるか――保健省の回答
triage.triage_reason: 国際的に拡大するリスクがあり（オランダ船でのアウトブレイク、複数国での検出）、異常・予想外なイベント（複数国での複数疾患の同時検出、船舶でのハンタウイルス感染とインフルエンザの報告）であり、IHR基準2つ以上を満たす。また、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、オランダの船舶MV Hondius号がアルゼンチン発カーボベルデ行きの航海中にハンタウイルスアウトブレイク（3死、WHO確認11例、アンデスウイルス9例）を報告。複数国での検出（ラテンアメリカ、カナリア諸島、オランダ）が記載されているが、対象国リストでは Brazil のみが該当。ウズベキスタンは対象国でないため verified_locations に含めない。国際的な移動・貿易制限リスク（国境管理、検疫強化）があり、IHR基準4つ全てに該当する重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế thông tin về chủng vi rút Hanta đang được WHO cảnh báo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health information about the Hantavirus strain that WHO is warning about.
article.articleSummary: On May 13, 2026, Vietnam’s Preventive Medicine Department cited WHO information about a hantavirus cluster linked to the international cruise MV Hondius. Eight cases have been reported on the ship, including three deaths; six cases tested positive for Andes virus (ANDV). WHO assesses medium risk for passengers and crew on the vessel and low global risk. Transmission differs from COVID-19. The infection source is under investigation; WHO currently favors a scenario in which the index case contracted the virus during outdoor exposure or rodent contact before boarding, with limited person-to-person spread possible aboard. Early symptoms include headache, dizziness, chills, fever, myalgias, and gastrointestinal symptoms (nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain). For high-risk contacts, 42-day home or suitable-facility isolation is advised; low-risk individuals should self-monitor. Vietnam reports no related cases; authorities urge surveillance, hygiene, rodent control, and prompt medical care if symptoms appear, and will continue updates with WHO.

triage.headline_ja: WHO が警告しているハンタウイルス株についての保健省の情報
triage.triage_reason: 国際的な船舶での集団発生（8例、死亡3例）、IHR基準3つ該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準4つ該当（異常性・重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性）。国際クルーズ船での多国籍集団発生はシグナル価値高。
triage.notes: MV Hondius国際クルーズ船での多国籍集団発生事例。記事ではベトナムが監視機関として報告主体であり、ベトナム国内での関連症例なしと明記。ただし船舶という国際的な環境での発生とWHOの複数国リスク評価により、国際的拡大リスク明確。Andes virus（ANDV）の確認と死亡率の高さが重症度を強調。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch lở mồm long móng đe dọa xâm nhập, Đà Nẵng kích hoạt phòng dịch, siết chặt biên giới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Foot-and-mouth disease threatens to invade; Da Nang activates epidemic prevention measures and tightens border controls.
article.articleSummary: Da Nang City issued an emergency directive to prevent the introduction of Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) caused by the Serotype SAT1 virus into Vietnam. The measure mandates vaccination funding and immunization of livestock to meet regulatory coverage, with boosters for unvaccinated animals, newborns, or those with waned immunity. Weekly progress reports must be sent to the Department of Agriculture and Rural Development. Enhanced surveillance for suspected FMD cases on farms, especially near borders, is required; suspected cases must be reported, samples collected, and virus typing performed to contain outbreaks. Border controls on movement of animals and animal products at border zones, markets, slaughterhouses, and collection points must be tightened. Veterinary authorities will cooperate with police, border guards, and market regulators to halt illegal transport. Public awareness campaigns promote biosafe farming and avoiding animals of unknown origin. Local plans and funding are required; agencies coordinate to prevent invasion and spread in Da Nang.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫がベトナム侵入を脅かす、ダナンが感染症対策を発動し国境管理を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫（FMD）のSAT1型ウイルスがベトナムへの侵入を脅かしており、ダナン市が緊急指令で対策を発動している。異常・予想外の重要動物疾病で、国境管理強化が既に実施されている点から、国際的拡大リスクと管理上の関心が高い。
triage.notes: 口蹄疫SAT1型はアフリカ由来で高い感染性を持つ。ベトナムの緊急対応とダナンでの国境管理強化は、地域での流行拡大を懸念していることを示している。動物疾病であるが、社会・経済的影響（畜産・食糧供給）が大きく、政府の関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Wamenkes: Hantavirus di Indonesia Tak Seperti Varian Mematikan di Kapal Pesiar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Health Minister: Hantavirus in Indonesia Is Not Like the Deadly Variant on Cruise Ships.
article.articleSummary: As of May 13, 2026, Indonesia has recorded 23 hantavirus cases since 2023, all classified as Hantavirus Fever Renal Syndrome (HFRS) with about 15% case-fatality, far below Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS) whose fatality can reach 60–80%. Globally, two main hantavirus variants exist: HFRS and HPS; Indonesia has not detected HPS. Transmission mirrors leptospirosis, via rodents such as rats, especially in areas with poor sanitation or after floods. Because of overlapping symptoms, the Ministry of Health now mandates double testing for patients suspected of leptospirosis to screen for hantavirus. The deputy health minister stressed the situation is not as dangerous as COVID-19 and did not disclose case locations due to confidentiality. Regarding the MV Hondius cruise ship fatalities, the WHO is investigating human-to-human transmission, which remains unconfirmed, with three deaths aboard under review.

triage.headline_ja: 副大臣：インドネシアのハンタウイルスは船舶での致命的な変異株のようではない
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスとレプトスピラの同時検出によりスクリーニング基準1つ以上に該当するが、情報が限定的（症例所在地の非開示、ヒト-ヒト感染未確認）であり、社会的関心は限定的のため経過観察対象
triage.notes: 3疾患（COVID-19、ハンタウイルス、レプトスピラ）が同時報告される複合イベント。インドネシアではハンタウイルス熱（HFRS）のみで、より危険なハンタウイルス肺症候群（HPS）は未検出。レプトスピラとの同時検査義務化により検出強化の可能性。MV Hondius船でのWHOによる人-人感染調査中だが未確認。症例所在地が未開示のため、地域的な流行拡大リスクの評価が困難。

locations.name: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

article.articleHeadline: இலங்கையில் 48 மணி நேரத்திற்கு மேலாக காய்ச்சல், அறிகுறிகள் நீடிப்பவர்களுக்கு விடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ள எச்சரிக்கை - தமிழ்வின்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Sri Lanka, a warning has been issued for those with fever lasting more than 48 hours and persistent symptoms - Tamilvin.
article.articleSummary: Dengue and malaria remain a health concern in Sri Lanka, though eradicated. Doctors warn of rising dengue and malaria among returning travelers and foreigners. In 2025 there were 29 dengue deaths; in the first five months of 2026 there have been 14 dengue deaths. Sri Lanka recorded 68 dengue cases in 2025, with 34 Indian returnees and 34 Sri Lankan nationals among them. Malaria, though eliminated since 2016, persists via imported cases. In 2025, 42 people who arrived from abroad were infected, and 3 malaria deaths were reported. In 2026 so far, 11 malaria cases have been detected, all among travelers who had gone abroad. Symptoms include high fever, body aches, retro-orbital pain, vomiting, and diarrhea; authorities urge those with fever lasting more than 48 hours or persistent symptoms to seek medical care immediately. District centers should conduct appropriate testing.

triage.headline_ja: スリランカで48時間以上続く発熱と持続的な症状を有する者に対して警告が発令
triage.triage_reason: デング熱とマラリアの同時流行シグナルであり、2026年にはデング熱で14人の死亡、マラリアで11例が報告されている。ただしスリランカは対象国ではなく、インドの事例が限定的（輸入症例）であるため、現時点では情報不足のまま継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はスリランカにおけるデング熱・マラリア警告だが、スリランカは対象国ではないため verified_locations から除外。インドは輸入症例（スリランカで検出された帰国者等）として限定的に言及されており、インド国内での流行状況の詳細は不明。IHR基準で2項目以上該当するが、対象国でのエビデンス不足のためWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Waspadai Penyakit Zoonosis Antraks Jelang Idul Adha 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware the zoonotic disease anthrax ahead of Eid al-Adha 2026.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax alert issued by Indonesia's Ministry of Health ahead of Eid al-Adha 2026. Bacillus anthracis, a spore-forming zoonotic bacterium, poses risk from livestock. Transmission routes include direct contact with infected animals, inhalation of contaminated air, consumption of undercooked meat, and exposure to soil and contaminated slaughter waste. Data show 81 anthrax cases in 2023 with 3 deaths; cases declined through 2024–2026, with no deaths recorded in 2025 and 2026. Most cases are cutaneous anthrax; gastrointestinal and meningitis forms exist and are the most dangerous. The warning was issued by Dr. Andi Saguni, Acting Director General for Disease Control, at a press briefing at the Bakom Government Office in Gambir, Central Jakarta, on May 13, 2026. Authorities aim to minimize or prevent fatalities during the holiday season and prevent outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年イード・アル=アドハーを前にしたズーノーシス疾患炭疽病に注意
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで炭疽病の公式警告が発令されており、複数の感染経路と死亡例の既往歴が存在するが、2025-2026年の現在は死亡例なしで発症件数も減少傾向にあるため、情報不足の状況での予防的警戒段階と判断。
triage.notes: インドネシア保健省が公式警告を発令しており、イード・アル=アドハー（家畜の屠殺を伴う宗教祭）を控えた時期であることから社会的・政治的関心は高い。ただし記事サマリーでは2025-2026年の死亡例がなく、発症件数も減少傾向にあるため、現在の深刻度は限定的。家畜との直接接触や食肉消費を通じた長期曝露リスクと、人間-動物間の感染しやすさが存在するためWPRO基準2つを満たす。IHR基準は現在のところ国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候がないため未充足。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Bangka pastikan tidak ada penularan lanjutan malaria - ANTARA News Bangka Belitung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bangka Health Office Ensures No Ongoing Malaria Transmission
article.articleSummary: As of May 13, 2026, in Bangka Regency, Bangka Belitung Islands, Indonesia, the Health Office reports no ongoing malaria transmission in Dusun Bubus and Dusun Batu Atap after vector-control (PSN) and hospital treatment. More than 200 residents were screened, revealing 24 malaria cases across the two hamlets; seven patients remain in treatment, while others have recovered. Local authorities have declared a malaria outbreak (KLB) in these communities. The district previously had malaria eliminated per World Health Organization status. Many residents are migrant tin miners from outside Bangka Regency. The government provides free health services to malaria patients not enrolled in BPJS Health. Authorities urge continued environmental cleanliness and vigilance to prevent future transmission.

triage.headline_ja: バンカ保健局がマラリアの継続的な感染がないことを確認
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バンカ州）で24例のマラリア症例が報告された限定的な集団発生であり、異常性と重症度の基準に該当する可能性があるが、当局が制御下にあると報告しており、情報不足のため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: バンカ州はWHO基準で以前マラリア排除地域とされていたが、24例の症例が報告され公式に集団発生（KLB）が宣言されている。患者の多くは州外からの出稼ぎ労働者であり、地元当局は制御下にあると報告しているが、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Minta Warga Waspada Penyakit Menular Anthrax dari Hewan Kurban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Urges Public to Be Vigilant Against Anthrax from Sacrificial Animals.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax, a zoonotic disease from Bacillus anthracis, remains a concern in Indonesia during Eid al-Adha sacrificial slaughter. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected animals (cutaneous or inhalational), consumption of undercooked meat, and exposure to soil or waste. Three clinical forms include cutaneous, gastrointestinal, and anthrax meningitis. Data from the Ministry of Health show 81 cases in 2023 with 3 deaths; in 2024, 1 death; 2025 had no deaths; and as of 13 May 2026, no deaths reported in 2026. Exposure risk is highest during slaughter, processing, and consumption of infected meat. Four preventive steps are urged: (1) careful selection and purchase of animals; (2) segregation of healthy and sick animals during transport and holding; (3) use of PPE (apron, mask, gloves, boots) during slaughter and dressing; (4) proper disposal of waste with separation of solid and liquid waste. Authorities aim to minimize cases and deaths during the holiday.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省が家畜の屠畜時の炭疽病に対する警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで炭疽病の継続的な懸念が報告されているが、2026年の死亡例はなく、新規の大規模発生の証拠がない。予防的警告と公衆衛生ガイダンスが主要内容であり、フルRRAの前に続報を注視すべき段階。
triage.notes: 炭疽病は季節性があり、イード・アル・アドハー（犠牲祭）時期に感染リスクが上昇することが明記されている。2023年に81件と3件の死亡があった過去データがあるが、2026年現在は死亡例がない。懸念はあるが発生の急速な悪化の兆候は見当たらない。公開されたサマリーは予防ガイダンスが中心であり、シグナル化の優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Haryana में डेंगू टेस्ट और प्लेटलेट्स के रेट फिक्स, मनमानी फीस वसूली तो अस्पतालों पर गिरेगी गाज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rates for dengue tests and platelets fixed in Haryana; penalties will fall on hospitals if they charge arbitrary fees.
article.articleSummary: Dengue, malaria, chikungunya and Japanese encephalitis are targeted in Haryana by fixed testing and treatment charges to curb rising vector-borne disease threats. The government caps private clinics at Rs 600 for ELISA-based and IgM dengue tests, and Rs 11,000 for single-donor platelet payments; overcharges invite sanctions. Government and private hospitals, clinics and labs must report suspected or confirmed cases to the civil surgeon within 24 hours. Inspections may include on-site checks, fogging, anti-larval actions, fever surveys, and blood sampling. If a private lab lacks ELISA testing, samples must be sent to a government lab or hospital; dengue cannot be declared positive without confirmation. Four negligent acts are punishable: non-adherence to NVBDCP protocol, not informing health department, declaring positives without confirmatory tests, and incorrect patient details. Fines: Rs 1,000 (first), Rs 5,000 (second), Rs 10,000 (third+); persistent violations may invoke Epidemic Diseases Act, 1897, section 3.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤナ州でデング熱検査と血小板の料金を固定、恣意的な手数料徴収の場合は病院に罰金
triage.triage_reason: 複数の蚊媒介性疾患（デング熱、マラリア、チクングニア、日本脳炎）の同時発生が示唆されているが、記事は主に料金規制と行政措置に関する公衆衛生対応であり、具体的な患者数、死亡数、流行規模などのイベント詳細情報が不足している。スクリーニング基準では異常性と管理可能性で懸念が認められるが、重症度や国際的拡大リスクについては判断材料不足のため、情報の充実を待って判断する必要がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが列挙した4つの疾患（日本脳炎、チクングニア、マラリア、デング熱）がハリヤナ州で同時多発的に増加しており、異常・予想外の状況と判断される。記事はハリヤナ州政府による公衆衛生対応（料金上限設定、報告義務化、罰則）について述べており、蚊媒介性疾患に対する長期曝露リスクが存在することが明確である。しかし患者数、死亡数、具体的な流行状況についての定量的情報がないため、詳細なリスク評価にはさらなる情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus, stesse scene del Covid. Ospedale Spallanzani: "Noi pronti"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus, the same scenes as COVID-19. Spallanzani Hospital: "We're ready".
article.articleSummary: 338 officially reported hantavirus cases worldwide across 70 countries, including Italy, with China data missing; infections are not all linked to the cruise that started the concern. Rome’s Spallanzani Hospital has been placed on pre-alert. Infectious disease expert Emanuele Nicastri notes that Andes hantavirus is known, but cases are rare and research limited; the Hondius episode could be the largest outbreak yet. Early symptoms are nonspecific fever, muscle pain, respiratory difficulty, and gastrointestinal issues, complicating incubation assessment. In Italy, a British tourist linked to a Sant’Elena–Johannesburg flight was traced and quarantined at Milan’s Sacco Hospital; his accompanying traveler also quarantined, both testing negative. An Argentine tourist from an endemic area, arriving in Rome from Buenos Aires, developed pneumonia in Messina; samples will be analyzed at Spallanzani alongside a 25-year-old Calabrian in isolation. Health authorities emphasize very low risk and cite Italy’s updated pandemic plan enabling rapid responses to respiratory threats.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス、COVID-19と同じ場面。スパランツァーニ病院：「我々は準備ができている」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数国での症例報告、高度な警戒体制、ヒト-ヒト感染可能性ありの新興感染症。
triage.notes: 記事は70カ国での338件の公式報告があると述べるが、検証対象国の中では中国のみが直接言及されている（「中国データは欠落」という文脈で）。イタリア、アルゼンチン、南アフリカの地域は記事に記載されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれていない。クルーズ船（Hondius）関連のアウトブレイクは最大級である可能性あり。イタリアの病院が事前警報レベルに置かれており、スクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。

article.articleHeadline: WHO cảnh báo chùm ca virus Hanta gây tử vong, Việt Nam tăng cường giám sát
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of a cluster of fatal Hantavirus cases, Vietnam steps up surveillance
article.articleSummary: On May 13, 2026, WHO reported 11 hantavirus infections on the cruise vessel MV Hondius, including 3 deaths; 9 cases are Andes virus (ANDV). WHO assigns medium risk for passengers and crew, low risk for the global community. Transmission is not like COVID-19; investigations continue. Early hypotheses point to environmental exposure or rodent contact before boarding, with possible limited human-to-human transmission on close, prolonged contact. Vietnam's Preventive Medicine Department, MOH, issued an urgent dispatch; as of 13 May, no Vietnamese citizens are linked to the cluster. Vietnam has stepped up border and healthcare surveillance, environmental hygiene, rodent control, and measures to prevent animal-to-human spread. No Andes virus cases have been confirmed in Vietnam; Seoul virus has been seen in animals in prior studies. Citizens should not speculate; monitor health for 42 days from last exposure and seek care if fever, headache, dizziness, muscle pain, GI symptoms, cough, or dyspnea appear.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがハンタウイルスの死亡事例のクラスターに警告、ベトナムが監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」と「国際的拡大リスク」に該当（2基準以上）。多国籍クルーズ船での複数死亡を伴うハンタウイルスクラスターは公衆衛生上の深刻な異常事象であり、国際的な船舶関連リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性を含む。WPROスクリーニングでも「重症度」「流行性」「長期曝露」に該当。ベトナムが正式に対応を強化しており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: イベントはクルーズ船（MV Hondius）上で発生しているが、ベトナムが公式対応・強化監視を実施している主要対象国。WHO中程度リスク評価、死亡3件、限定的ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、国際クルーズ船という高リスク環境による国際的拡大懸念。ハンタウイルスはベトナムで未確認だが、周辺国での既知感染に加え、国際的な船舶由来のクラスター拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Phòng, chống virus Hanta: Việt Nam tăng cường giám sát tại cửa khẩu, cơ sở khám bệnh, chữa bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus Prevention and Control: Vietnam Strengthens Surveillance at Border Crossings and Healthcare Facilities.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's National Institute reports a Hantavirus cluster linked to the MV Hondius. As of May 8, 2026, 8 cases with 3 deaths; 6 lab-confirmed infections, all Andes virus (ANDV). WHO assesses risk to passengers and crew as medium; global risk is low. Transmission differs from COVID-19; investigation is ongoing. The index case may have been exposed to rodent-contaminated environments before boarding, with limited human-to-human transmission aboard. No final conclusions; avoid premature source attribution. For those aboard the ship and flights, WHO advises 42 days of monitoring after last exposure; monitor for headache, dizziness, fever, myalgia, GI symptoms, and maintain hand hygiene. High-risk contacts should undergo active monitoring and home isolation for 42 days; low-risk should self-monitor. No Vietnamese citizens linked; strengthen border and facility surveillance, cleaning, disinfection, and rodent control. Vietnam has not recorded Andes virus; Seoul virus in animals. Authorities will coordinate with WHO and keep the public updated.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス予防・対策：ベトナムが国境検問所と医療施設での監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: MV Hondius船上でのハンタウイルス（アンデス株）のクラスター事例（8例、死亡3例）が確認され、WHO評価による中程度のリスク、異常・予想外の発生、複数国への国際的拡大リスク（船舶・航空便利用者）があり、IHR基準3項目に該当。国家規模での監視体制強化と国際協調が必要。
triage.notes: MV Hondius船上のハンタウイルス・クラスター（アンデス株、ベトナム初記録）。死亡率37.5%（3/8）と高く、乗船者・航空利用者への国際的な波及リスクが高い。ベトナムにはアンデス株の自然循環がなく、船上または乗船前の野鼠曝露が主要な感染源と推定される。WHO中程度リスク評価、42日間の接触者監視体制が展開中。

article.articleHeadline: Bird Flu : सावधान! बर्ड फ्लूचा विळखा अधिकच घट्ट; ४ लाख कोंबड्या आणि लाखो अंडी नष्ट, प्रशासनाचा मोठा निर्णय
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird Flu: Caution! The grip of bird flu has tightened even further; 400,000 chickens and millions of eggs destroyed, the administration's major decision.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza outbreak in Navapur area, Nandurbar district, Maharashtra, India, has intensified. Six poultry farms tested positive for the virus, triggering a large-scale culling operation. So far, about 389,000 chickens have been culled; overall destruction includes roughly 400,000 chickens, more than 2.1 million eggs, and 50 tonnes of poultry feed. The response aims to contain the outbreak in the Navapur area; actions are ongoing. The report does not provide further details on human cases or laboratory confirmation beyond the six positive farm samples. These developments are dated 13 May 2026. The measures reflect a government-led containment effort with emphasis on mass culling and disposal of potentially infected materials. The update underscores ongoing losses to poultry stock and feed.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ：警告！鳥インフルエンザの危機がさらに深刻化；40万羽の鶏と数百万個の卵を破棄、当局の大規模決定
triage.triage_reason: インドのマハラシュトラ州で鳥インフルエンザの大規模集団発生が確認され、40万羽近い鶏の殺処分と大量の卵・飼料の破棄が実施されている。IHR基準で「異常・予想外」および「公衆衛生への影響」が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が複数該当するシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいてインドのマハラシュトラ州ナワプール地域での鳥インフルエンザ集団発生が主題。6つの家禽農場の陽性確認、39万羽以上の殺処分、210万個以上の卵破棄が報告されている。人間感染例の記述はないが、家禽での大規模感染と集団殺処分は重大な公衆衛生・農業経済影響を示唆。鳥インフルエンザから人間への感染リスク考慮により国際的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: 51 Balai Karantina Disiagakan Antisipasi Hantavirus Masuk Indonesia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 51 Quarantine Offices on Standby to Anticipate Hantavirus Entry into Indonesia
article.articleSummary: Indonesia is bolstering hantavirus defense by staging 51 Quarantine Health Offices nationwide to prevent importation. Acting Director General Andi Saguni states these offices serve as frontline guardians, enhancing surveillance when outbreaks rise abroad. Digital screening replaces manual checks at entry points, featuring thermal scanners, barcode-based health data, and rapid hospital referrals for suspicious travelers from high-risk regions. Clarifying strains linked to the MV Hondius cruise ship, authorities note HPS (hantavirus pulmonary syndrome) is primarily in South America and has not been reported in Indonesia, while locally circulating HFRS (hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome) is caused by Seoul virus and has been present in Indonesia since 1991. No evidence of human-to-human transmission for Seoul virus exists, but the public is advised to maintain environmental hygiene to reduce rodent exposure, the main hantavirus host.

triage.headline_ja: 51の検疫所がインドネシアへのハンタウイルス侵入に対する警戒態勢を整える
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるハンタウイルス感染症への事前対応（予防的措置）の記事であり、現在の流行発生ではなく准備段階の報道。HFRS（腎症候性出血熱）はインドネシアで1991年から既知で風土病化している。国内での新規流行の報告はなく、スクリーニング基準1つ程度の該当にとどまるが、国の関心が高く続報価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアの予防的防御措置（51の検疫所の警戒態勢）を主題としており、現在の流行事例ではない。HFRS（ソウルウイルス）はインドネシアで風土病化（1991年以来）しており、HPS（ハンタウイルス肺症候群）は南米が主流であり国内報告なし。ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠なし。政府と国民の関心は高いが、疾病の深刻度や国際的拡大リスクは現在低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ancaman Virus Hanta dari Tikus, Dinkes Belitung Timur Minta Waspada Meski Belum Ditemukan Kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Hantavirus Threat From Rats: East Belitung Health Office Urges Vigilance Even Though No Cases Have Been Found.
article.articleSummary: In East Belitung Regency, Indonesia, health officials warn of hantavirus exposure risk despite zero confirmed cases in East Belitung or the Bangka Belitung Islands. The virus is carried by rodents, primarily rats, and transmission occurs via contact with rat urine, feces, or bites. Early symptoms include severe muscle pains, notably in the back and calves, resembling flu or common fever; respiratory symptoms and Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS) may appear weeks later, typically 6–8 weeks after onset, with shortness of breath. There are no confirmed hantavirus cases to date in Belitung Timur or across Babel. Authorities are increasing surveillance, particularly for residents with travel from outbreak areas. Residents are urged to seek care for prolonged muscle pain with breathlessness and report travel history to health centers; educational flyers are distributed to prevent panic and break transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: ネズミからのハンタウイルスの脅威：東ベリトゥン保健局は症例が発見されていないにもかかわらず警戒を呼びかけている
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染の潜在的リスク警告だが、現在のところ確定症例はなく、情報が限定的。ただし公衆衛生上の関心と地域的な警戒体制が存在するため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は予警的性質で、確定症例がないため直ちのシグナル認定は保留。しかし地域保健当局による能動的な警戒と監視体制が敷かれており、今後の症例報告があれば速やかにPICKUPへ昇格させる必要がある。ハンタウイルスはヒト‐ヒト感染が限定的で、ネズミ媒介による長期曝露リスクが主要な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Ativa, saudável e apaixonada pelo neto: quem era a mulher que morreu por hepatite A em Juiz de Fora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Active, healthy and devoted to her grandson: who was the woman who died of hepatitis A in Juiz de Fora.
article.articleSummary: Juiz de Fora, Minas Gerais, Brazil confirmed the first Hepatitis A death of 2026: a 60-year-old caregiver, Angela Cristina Terra Pinto, who died April 30 after severe sepsis and liver failure. The hospital confirmed Hepatitis A via infection-control labs, but the municipal government says the death remains under investigation, as lab results are only one step in establishing causality alongside clinical, epidemiological, and risk-factor data. By end-April, Juiz de Fora had 808 Hepatitis A cases, representing more than 70% of Minas Gerais’ 2026 total and the highest city-wide count in a decade. Cases are spread across the city, concentrated in the central area and south zone. The family believes infection occurred after the February 23 floods, when she helped friends on February 24; authorities note the incubation period is compatible. The state health department says Juiz de Fora is not in an outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 健康で活発、孫を溺愛していた女性：フォルタレザでジカ熱で死亡した女性は誰だったのか
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのジュイス・デ・フォーラで2026年初の肝炎A死亡例が確認され、市内で70%以上の州別症例集中、10年間で最高の感染数を記録している。IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な数値）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはポルトガル語の見出しと英語要約の内容に基づく。ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州のジュイス・デ・フォーラにおける肝炎A集団感染の中で初の死亡例が報告された。2月の洪水後の発症パターン、市内での広範な分布、州全体の70%以上の集中という異常な疫学パターンが特徴。自治体は「アウトブレイク状態ではない」と主張しているが、死亡の直接的な因果関係は検査中とのこと。感染源となった環境要因（洪水に関連した汚染）が存在することが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Tips Cegah Virus Hanta dari Dinkes Beltim, Pakai Sarung Tangan dan Disinfektan saat Bersih-bersih
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus Prevention Tips from the Beltim Health Office: Wear Gloves and Use Disinfectant During Cleaning.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus prevention tips from Beltim Health Office address East Belitung Regency (Belitung Timur). Officials advise against sweeping rodent droppings immediately; instead, spray disinfectant on droppings first to kill viruses and mold spores that can become airborne. Wear gloves during cleaning and avoid direct hand contact. Food safety is emphasized: keep foods sealed and discard items touched or chewed by rats to prevent rapid transmission. Officials note hantavirus spread depends on household cleanliness and is not as easily transmitted person-to-person as COVID-19. Ongoing district surveillance and community education campaigns are being conducted, with residents urged to maintain home cleanliness and seek care at local puskesmas (public health clinic) if unwell after cleaning.

triage.headline_ja: ベリトゥン保健所からのハンタウイルス予防のヒント：清掃時に手袋を着用し消毒剤を使用してください
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染の予防啓発記事であり、実際の感染事例の報告ではなく、定期的な家庭衛生管理と監視活動の実施が述べられている。公衆衛生への具体的な深刻な影響を示す情報が不足しており、WPROスクリーニング基準の詳細な判断に必要な疫学情報（患者数、重症度、致死率など）が記事に含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はハンタウイルス予防のための啓発・教育記事であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。ベリトゥン地域でのハンタウイルス患者数、重症度、死亡例に関する具体的なデータが記事に記載されていない。COVID-19との比較提示（人人感染の可能性が低い）はあるが、詳細な疫学情報が不足しているため、完全なリスク評価のための続報を要注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Cách ly 42 ngày với người nguy cơ cao nhiễm virus Hanta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 42-day quarantine for high-risk individuals infected with hantavirus.
article.articleSummary: WHO advises active monitoring and a 42-day quarantine for high-risk contacts of hantavirus infections. On May 13, 2026, Vietnam’s Department of Disease Prevention issued an urgent update, calling for strengthened border and clinical surveillance, vehicle disinfection, vector and rodent control, and proactive preventive measures. Vietnam notes hantavirus surveillance exists and no Andes virus (ANDV) cases have been recorded domestically; prior Vietnamese studies involved Seoul virus or rodent-associated hantaviruses, distinct from the virus linked to an outbreak on the international cruise ship MV Hondius. Authorities urge calm, rely on official information, maintain environmental hygiene and rodent control, and seek medical care if exposed to rodent droppings and develop fever, myalgia, fatigue, GI symptoms, or respiratory issues. WHO reports, as of May 8, 2026, the Hondius cluster: 8 cases, 3 deaths; 6 laboratory-confirmed ANDV infections; global risk low, passenger/crew risk moderate. Transmission differs from COVID-19; 42-day health monitoring for those on board or with related flights after last exposure; low-risk contacts self-monitoring. No Vietnamese citizens linked to the cluster yet.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス感染症リスク者の42日間隔離
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス（Andes virus）の国際的な海上クルーズ船での集団発生に関連し、ベトナムが公式な監視強化と隔離措置を発令。死亡例を含む確認症例があり、WHOも報告。国際的拡大リスク（渡航関連）が存在するため、IHR基準3つ以上に該当する可能性が高い。
triage.notes: MV Hondius国際クルーズ船でのAndes virusの集団発生（8例、3死亡、6例ラボ確認）がトリガー。ベトナムは国内でのAndV症例は未報告だが、境界監視強化・臨床監視・車両消毒・げっ歯類制御を指示。WHO報告（2026年5月8日時点）で国際リスク低だが、乗客・乗員リスクは中程度。COVID-19との違いを強調し、ベトナム国民との直接関連はまだなし。国際的な感染症イベント（渡航関連感染症）として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mahyeldi Dukung Usulan Pasien TBC Dapat MBG: Banyak Penderita dari Keluarga Miskin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mahyeldi Backs Proposal for TB Patients to Receive MBG: Many Patients from Poor Families.
article.articleSummary: Padang, West Sumatra, Governor Mahyeldi Ansharullah endorsed the Health Ministry's proposal to provide Free Nutritious Meals (MBG) for tuberculosis (TB) patients from low-income families, stressing that nutrition supports TB recovery and that most patients come from poor communities. The central government also plans to renovate TB patients' homes through the Housing Ministry, and will supply health equipment, including portable X-ray units, to reach puskesmas and even jorong villages. At the provincial level, West Sumatra maintains a by-name, by-address TB patient database to streamline treatment and identify substandard housing for intervention. Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus proposed MBG for poor TB patients during a visit, and the central government aims to renovate at least 300 TB homes in Sumatra Barat this year. The provincial government will coordinate with districts and relevant agencies to implement these measures.

triage.headline_ja: マヒェルディ知事がTBC患者向けMBG支給提案を支持：多くの患者が貧困家族出身
triage.triage_reason: 結核患者向けの栄養支援プログラムと住宅改善イニシアティブに関する政策ニュース。既知疾患の社会支援施策であり、異常な発生や急速な拡大の可能性はなく、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核患者への社会支援政策（栄養補助と住宅改善）に関する地域ニュースであり、感染症イベント自体ではなく政策実施の報告である。新規感染症シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Hantavirus, Dinkes Boyolali Ingatkan Bahaya Penularan dari Tikus hingga Picu Gagal Ginjal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus Alert: Boyolali Health Office Warns of the Dangers of Transmission from Rats That Can Lead to Kidney Failure
article.articleSummary: As of May 13, 2026, the Boyolali Regency Health Office in Central Java, Indonesia warns hantavirus can be transmitted from rat feces, urine, and saliva, potentially causing kidney failure and severe lung involvement. Risk peaks when people clean barns, attics, or homes with many rodents without protective gear. Several suspected cases have emerged in Indonesia, and a hantavirus-related death was reported aboard the MV Hondius cruise from Argentina. There is no specific antiviral or vaccine; treatment is supportive, including ICU care, O2, ventilation, ECMO, and dialysis if kidney failure occurs. Warning signs include fever with severe muscle pain (back or thighs), headache, and recent rat exposure within 1–8 weeks, plus breathlessness, O2 sat <94%, hypotension, and reduced urine output. Prevention emphasizes three measures: seal rodent entry points (>0.5 cm) with mesh, store food in sealed containers, and disinfect droppings with a wet method using 1:10 bleach after 5–15 minutes.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス警報：ボヨラリ保健所がネズミからの感染の危険性を警告、腎不全を引き起こす可能性
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでハンタウイルス感染症の疑い例が複数報告されており、アルゼンチン発のクルーズ船での死亡事例も含まれている。人間への影響があり、国際的な拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドネシア（ボヨラリ地区、中部ジャワ州）でのハンタウイルス疑い例複数と、アルゼンチン発のクルーズ船での死亡事例を報告している。発生地域にはアルゼンチン共和国も含まれているが、記事の主題は、インドネシアでの警告と保健指導がメインである。当該記事は、インドネシアでの複数の疑い例と国際的な影響（クルーズ船での死亡）の両面で、シグナルとしてピックアップすべき情報である。ハンタウイルスは重症度が高く（腎不全、肺関与、死亡の可能性）、人間への影響、国際的拡大リスク、長期曝露の可能性（ネズミによる環境汚染）があり、複数のスクリーニング基準に合致する。

article.articleHeadline: Việt Nam chưa ghi nhận công dân có liên quan đến chùm ca bệnh do virus Hanta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam has not yet recorded any citizens related to a cluster of Hantavirus cases.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam has not reported any citizens linked to the MV Hondius hantavirus cluster. As of May 8–9, 2026, WHO data on the voyage show 8 hantavirus cases with 3 deaths, with 6 cases laboratory-confirmed as Andes virus (ANDV). Global risk is described as low, while the risk to ship passengers and crew is medium; transmission patterns differ from COVID-19. Investigations point to a possible initial exposure before boarding via outdoor exposure or rodent contact, with limited human-to-human spread on board; a final infection-source conclusion has not been reached. No speculation should be made about ship, food, or water sources pending official results. Health measures call for 42 days of monitoring after last exposure for those on the ship and related flights; watch for fever, headache, dizziness, chills, myalgia, and gastrointestinal symptoms, with emphasis on hand hygiene. High-risk contacts should undergo active monitoring and home isolation for 42 days; low-risk individuals should self-monitor. Vietnam reinforces surveillance, vector/rodent control, and hospital hygiene, awaiting further WHO updates.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムはハンタウイルスの集団感染に関連する市民をまだ記録していない
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症（Andes virus）の国際的な船舶関連集団発生であり、IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク・重症度（死亡例あり）が複数該当。WPROスクリーニングでも異常性・重症度・流行性が明確。
triage.notes: MV Hondius船での国際的なハンタウイルス（Andes virus）集団発生。確認症例8件、死亡3件、6件が実験室確認。ベトナムは直接の患者報告なしとしているが、関連する乗客・乗員の健康監視と対応に関与している。42日間の監視期間と感染経路調査が進行中。国際的な船舶関連感染症として高い関心。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế thông tin khẩn sau khi WHO công bố 8 ca nghi mắc vi rút Hanta trên tàu du lịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health issues urgent information after the WHO announced 8 suspected hantavirus cases on a cruise ship.
article.articleSummary: Eight suspected hantavirus cases on cruise MV Hondius as of May 8, including 6 laboratory-confirmed Andes virus (ANDV) infections and 3 deaths. WHO assigns medium risk to passengers and crew aboard, with global risk deemed low; transmission differs from COVID-19. No final conclusions on source; current hypothesis suggests an index case may have been exposed to rodent-contaminated environment before boarding, with limited human-to-human spread possible on the ship. No definitive links to ship, food, or water are established. Vietnam’s Ministry of Health urges enhanced border and clinical surveillance, vessel disinfection, vector/rodent control, and preventive measures. Ongoing WHO and national monitoring will update risk assessments. People on the ship and related flights should monitor health for 42 days after last exposure, watching for fever, headache, dizziness, chills, myalgia, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and maintain hand hygiene. No Vietnamese nationals linked to the cluster were reported.

triage.headline_ja: WHO が船上での 8 件のハンタウイルス感染疑い例を報告した後、ベトナム保健省が緊急情報を発表
triage.triage_reason: 国際クラスター（船舶由来）、複数国への拡散リスク（乗客・乗員が複数国籍）、確認死亡事例3例を含む中程度重症性があり、IHR基準2つ以上（異常/予想外、国際拡散リスク）、WPRO基準3つ以上（重症度、流行リスク、管理可能性）に該当。WHO及び各国当局による活発な対応・国際モニタリングが進行中。
triage.notes: 国際クルーズ船（MV Hondius）上での多国籍クラスター。ラベル「COVID-19」が付与されているが、サマリーではハンタウイルス（Andes virus）が主題。ハンタウイルス感染は齧歯動物接触関連、ヒト-ヒト感染は限定的との記載。但し船上での3死亡、6確認例による重症性と国際拡散リスクは顕著。ベトナム保健省による国境検査強化と医療監視体制の展開が確認されており、WHO及び各国による継続的モニタリングが進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Estos son los 10 virus más peligrosos del mundo - DW.com - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Marburg virus identified in 1967 in Marburg, Germany along the Lahn River, cited as the most dangerous pathogen with 90% mortality; causes hemorrhagic fever with convulsions and widespread bleeding, initial outbreak linked to laboratory work with green monkeys from Uganda. Ebola is highlighted with six strains named after African regions (Zaire, Sudan, Bundibugyo, Bombali, Taï National Park) plus Reston, first detected in Reston, Virginia in 1989; Zaire Ebola is the most lethal, with outbreaks reporting mortality up to 90%. Philippine flying foxes are suspected to have introduced Zaire Ebola into urban settings. Hantaviruses, carried by rodents, yield two main conditions—Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS) and Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS)—and are named after a river linked to early infections during the Korean War (1950). Avian influenza strains are noted for high lethality, with about 70% mortality. Other dangerous viruses active globally continue to attract public health monitoring, especially those causing hemorrhagic fevers.

triage.headline_ja: 世界で最も危険な10のウイルス - DW.com
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は過去の歴史的なウイルス同定・アウトブレイク情報（1967年のマールブルグ、1989年のレストン）の教育的総括であり、現在進行形の感染症イベント・シグナルではない。記事は情報教育記事に過ぎず、新規または拡大中の公衆衛生上の脅威を示していない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIから付与された地域には複数国（米国、ドイツ、ウガンダ、フィリピン、コートジボワール）が含まれているが、これは過去の歴史的な病原体発見地・初期アウトブレイク地を列挙したものであり、現在の発生イベントではない。記事サマリーは危険なウイルスの一般的な知識情報であり、現在進行形の新規シグナルは含まれていない。対象国の現在の感染症イベントは記載されていないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ramai Hantavirus, Kemenkes Siagakan 51 Pos Karantina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus cases on the rise; Health Ministry deploys 51 quarantine posts.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus cases prompt Indonesia's Health Ministry to deploy 51 quarantine posts nationwide to prevent international entry of the disease, following heightened attention to hantavirus detected on the luxury cruise MV Hondius. The Interim Director General for Disease Control Andi Saguni stated the quarantine offices aim to stop infectious threats from entering Indonesia via international travel. Enhanced screening targets passengers arriving from identified high‑risk countries, including temperature checks with thermal scanners and health status assessments. A digital system replaces paper forms, using barcode scanning to monitor traveler health data and support rapid referrals. Suspected cases are directed to designated government hospitals. The measures underscore Indonesia’s preventive framework within the national health protection system; data collected feeds ongoing surveillance to shield borders and coordinate response for potential imported hantavirus cases. Published May 13, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス感染例が増加、保健省が全国に51カ所の隔離検査所を配置
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるハンタウイルス感染事例の増加に対応した政府レベルの強化対策（51カ所の隔離検査所配置、デジタル監視システム導入）が実施されており、国際的な防御体制の整備と潜在的な輸入感染症対策の実行を示唆するシグナル。WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、管理可能性、政府対応）を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ハンタウイルスはげっ歯類由来のウイルスで、ヒト-ヒト感染は限定的だが、国際的な懸念が高い。MV Hondius（豪華クルーズ船）での検出と国家規模の検疫体制整備は、国際保健規則(IHR)に関連する重要なイベント。記事サマリーはインドネシアでの実際の症例増加と政府の強化対策を明確に述べており、verified_locationsはインドネシアのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Perketat Bandara dan Pelabuhan, 51 Balai Karantina Disiagakan Cegah Hantavirus Masuk Indonesia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Tightens Airports and Seaports, 51 Quarantine Offices Put on Standby to Prevent Hantavirus from Entering Indonesia
article.articleSummary: Indonesia tightens surveillance at all international entry points as of May 13, 2026, deploying 51 Balai Kekarantinaan Kesehatan (BKK) at airports and seaports to screen travelers. Acting Director General of Disease Control and Prevention Andi Saguni says BKKs serve as the nation’s frontline defense against imported outbreaks, noting the renaming from Kantor Karantina Kesehatan to BKK while maintaining the same function. The measures respond to rising international mobility and cross-border threats, including hantavirus. The hantavirus case linked to the cruise ship MV Hondius illustrates the system in action, with authorities mapping passenger origin, travel history, and potential contacts entering Indonesia. Officials also tighten checks on travelers from high-risk countries and reinforce monitoring of inbound air and sea travelers.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省が空港と港湾を強化、ハンタウイルスのインドネシア流入を防ぐため51の検疫所を待機態勢に
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスは致死的な感染症だが、記事は国境での防御強化措置の実施であり、実際の確定症例や流行の報告ではない。情報が限定的であり、国内での病例の大規模発生を示す根拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事は「ハンタウイルスの流入防止」を目的とした予防的な検疫強化措置であり、インドネシア国内での確定患者や流行の報告ではない。MV Hondius関連の事例言及があるが、具体的な患者数や症状については記載がない。続報でインドネシア国内での確定症例や感染拡大が報告される場合はPICKUPに昇格する可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Hunger beneath the TB crisis: Study says 7,00,000 cases in India were avoidable - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Undernutrition drives TB in India. A Lancet modelling study, 'Global, regional, and national estimates of tuberculosis incidence averted by eliminating undernutrition in adults: a modelling study,' estimated that removing undernutrition (BMI below 18.5 kg/m2) could have prevented about 7.12 lakh adult TB cases in India in 2023, roughly 28.6% of all adult TB disease episodes; globally, nearly 2.3 million adult TB cases (23.7%) could have been averted. In Delhi, latent TB infection is reported in about 40% of residents, underscoring ongoing public health risk. The authors link poor nutrition to weaker immunity and higher TB susceptibility, with overcrowding, pollution, diabetes, smoking, stress, and delayed diagnosis exacerbating transmission. Policy responses highlighted include the CSR-backed Nikshay Mitra 'Food Basket' providing six months of nutritional support to TB patients and the Centre-led Energy Dense Nutrition Supplement programme for low-BMI patients. Data refer to 2023; published May 13, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 飢えがTB危機の背景に：研究によると、インドの700,000件の症例は回避可能だった
triage.triage_reason: インドにおける結核の大規模な負担（710万件の回避可能症例）を報告する疫学研究であり、異常性と重症度のスクリーニング基準に該当する可能性がある。ただし、これは新規発生アウトブレイク報告ではなく、既知の栄養不良とTBの関連性に関する事後分析モデリング研究であるため、IHR基準の緊急性は低い。社会的関心の程度が不明であるため経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は新規アウトブレイク報告ではなく、Lancet掲載の既知疾病に関する疫学モデリング研究（2023年データ分析、2026年5月発表）である。インドにおけるTBの高い負担と栄養不良の関連性が強調されており、公衆衛生政策における重要な知見であるが、シグナル検知という観点からはピックアップの優先度は低い。デリーにおける潜在性TB感染40%という高い有病率は注目に値する。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Wanti-wanti Antraks saat Idul Adha, Daging Kurban Jangan Asal Simpan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Warns About Anthrax During Eid al-Adha; Do Not Store Sacrificial Meat Carelessly.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Ministry of Health warns of anthrax risk during Eid al-Adha in Jakarta. The main threat is zoonotic Bacillus anthracis infection transmitted via contact with infected livestock, inhalation of spores, or consumption of inadequately cooked meat. Spores can persist in the environment, notably in slaughter waste. Human cases have declined recently: 2023 saw 81 cases with 3 deaths; 2024 had 1 death; by mid-2026 no deaths reported. Although cutaneous anthrax is most common, gastrointestinal and meningitis forms are more severe and fatal. Guidance urges safe handling and storage of sacrificial meat: ensure meat is fresh, cook promptly, refrigerate at 5°C or below for up to 4 days if not cooked, or freeze at −18 to −20°C for longer storage; always cook meat thoroughly and portion leftovers before refrigerating. Vigilance during Eid al-Adha remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がイード・アル・アドハ時のコメ炭疽病に警告、犠牲動物の肉を不注意に保管しないよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるコメ炭疽病の季節的リスク警告であり、最近の人的被害は限定的（2024年1死亡、2026年上半期は報告なし）。ただし動物-ヒト感染の可能性と公衆衛生ガイダンスの発行という背景から、続報を注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア保健省による季節的警告であり、現在進行中の流行ではなく予防的ガイダンスの発行。最近の人的死亡ケースは大幅に減少している（2024年1例以降報告なし）。ただしイード・アル・アドハ時の屠殺・食肉処理における動物-ヒト感染リスク（長期曝露・流行リスク）は存在。情報が公式ガイダンスに基づくため信頼性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Siagakan 51 Balai Karantina Kesehatan Antisipasi Hantavirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Mobilizes 51 Health Quarantine Centers to Guard Against Hantavirus
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Ministry of Health has activated 51 Health Quarantine Centers across the country to guard against hantavirus transmission. Acting Director General Andi Saguni said these centers prevent and counter infectious diseases arriving from abroad by monitoring travelers from high-risk countries and observing for symptoms. Entry screening uses thermal scanners and symptom checks, with passenger data recorded via a digital barcode system to enable rapid referral to designated hospitals if suspicious. The article notes hantavirus on the cruise ship MV Hondius as Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS), a type not reported in Indonesia. HPS is common in South America and linked to Andes virus, which can transmit between people in some settings. In Indonesia, hantavirus cases have involved Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS) caused by Seoul virus since 1991, with no evidence of human-to-human spread documented.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がハンタウイルス対策のため51の保健検疫センターを動員
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで新規のハンタウイルス肺症候群(HPS)が報告され、従来のHFRS型とは異なる病原体の侵入リスクが顕在化。政府による大規模な検疫体制強化と国際的監視が開始されており、シグナルとしての価値が高い。
triage.notes: 記事によると、インドネシアではこれまでハンタウイルスはソウルウイルス由来のHFRS型のみが報告されてきたが、MV Hondius船でのHPS(ハンタウイルス肺症候群)検出は新規病原体の侵入を示唆。HPS(アンデスウイルス関連)は南米で流行し、限定的なヒト-ヒト感染が報告されている。インドネシア政府による51センターの全国的な検疫体制強化は、この新規脅威への即応体制を反映している。

article.articleHeadline: Khuyến cáo phòng bệnh virus Hanta từ Bộ Y tế sau chùm ca nhiễm trên tàu MV Hondius
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Issues Hantavirus Prevention Recommendations After a Cluster of Infections on the MV Hondius
article.articleSummary: 8 hantavirus infection cases on the international cruise MV Hondius have been reported, with 3 deaths; WHO notes global risk is low, but risk to ship passengers and crew is medium. Vietnam’s Ministry of Health (Prevention Department) states no Vietnamese cases of Andes hantavirus linked to the Hondius cluster have been recorded, and no Vietnamese citizens are linked to the cluster. The infection source remains under investigation; scientists hypothesize the index case may have contracted the virus via the environment or rodents before boarding, with limited human-to-human transmission possibly on board. Vietnam urges localities to strengthen border and healthcare surveillance, environmental hygiene, vector and rodent control, and vessel sanitation. For those on the ship and related flights, 42-day health monitoring after last exposure is advised; monitor for fever, headache, dizziness, chills, myalgia, GI symptoms; high-risk contacts need active monitoring and home isolation, while low-risk individuals should self-monitor. No panic; ongoing coordination with WHO for updates.

triage.headline_ja: MV Hondius号でのハンタウイルス感染クラスター後、厚生省がハンタウイルス感染症予防勧告を発令
triage.triage_reason: 国際的な旅客船でのハンタウイルス感染クラスター（8症例、死亡3例）が確認され、WHO も乗客・乗員への中程度リスクを認定。ベトナムに対しては直接的な国内症例は報告されていないが、国境および医療監視強化が要請されており、国際的な感染拡大リスクが存在するため。
triage.notes: 国際旅客船MV Hondius上での8症例のハンタウイルス感染クラスターが報告された。死亡3例。WHOは船舶乗客・乗員への中程度リスクを評価。感染源は調査中。ベトナム国内への直接的な患者報告はないが、厚生省が国境監視、医療監視、環境衛生、ベクター・げっ歯類制御、船舶衛生強化を要請し、高リスク接触者に42日間の健康監視を指示。国際的な感染拡大リスク、乗客・乗員の追跡の必要性により、IHR基準4項目全て、WPRO基準5項目全て該当。

article.articleHeadline: Warga Ketapang Kalbar Meninggal Usai Terjangkit Hantavirus, Penularan dari Hewan ke Manusia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ketapang Residents in West Kalimantan Die After Contracting Hantavirus, Animal-to-Human Transmission.
article.articleSummary: As of May 13, 2026, Ketapang Regency, West Kalimantan, Indonesia reports one confirmed hantavirus case with the patient dying after treatment at RSUD dr Agoessdjam Ketapang; the deceased had comorbidity. Nationally, the Ministry of Health lists 23 hantavirus cases, with Ketapang the sole Indonesian case. The infection is Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS), transmitted from animals to humans (rats), not human-to-human. Authorities distinguish this from Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS) associated with MV Hondius, noting no person-to-person transmission. People working in damp areas, warehouses, drainage systems, or farming should be vigilant, as most patients had exposure to rat habitats. Preventive measures include keeping homes clean, avoiding waste buildup, sealing rodent entry, and safeguarding food and water. Individuals should recognize hantavirus symptoms and seek care promptly at local health facilities.

triage.headline_ja: 西カリマンタン州ケタパン住民がハンタウイルス感染後に死亡、動物から人間への感染
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染による死亡事例が報告されており、国内で確認された初の事例。HFRS（腎症候性出血熱）は重症度が高く、公衆衛生への影響が深刻。対象国インドネシアで検証済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーからインドネシア（ケタパン地域）での確認事例が主題。国内初のハンタウイルス死亡事例として報告されている。HFRS（腎症候性出血熱）はげっ歯類からの動物由来感染症であり、人間から人間への伝播なし。公衆衛生当局の対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 4 Negara Asia dengan Paparan Hantavirus Tertinggi, Ada Indonesia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four Asian countries with the highest hantavirus exposure, including Indonesia.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus exposure linked to the MV Hondius cruise ship cluster in May 2026 prompted heightened surveillance across Asia. Hantavirus is a rodent-borne zoonosis that can cause hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) and serious respiratory illness. The WHO says the cluster is not Covid-19 and global risk remains low. China accounts for about 90% of global HFRS cases, with most infections in northern and northeastern rural areas; Seoul and Hantaan viruses predominate, and China maintains national surveillance. South Korea reports hundreds of HFRS cases annually, linked to wild rats in forests and farms, with autumn peaks. Indonesia shows high small-mammal hantavirus prevalence (17.49%), urban rats carrying the virus; eight HFRS cases were reported across four provinces in 2025, all recovered. Singapore records 10.53% prevalence among small mammals; Singaporean passengers tied to MV Hondius are monitored. India tightens checks; Thailand and Vietnam report rodent-related hantavirus activity, no major outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス曝露が最も高いアジアの4カ国、インドネシアも含む
triage.triage_reason: 複数国にまたがるハンタウイルス関連の国際的なクラスター（MV Hondius船舶）が報告されており、IHR基準で国際的拡大リスク、複数国への影響が確認される。WPROスクリーニングでも異常性・流行しやすさ・管理可能性の複数基準に該当。
triage.notes: MV Hondius船舶での国際的なハンタウイルスクラスターが引き金となり、複数アジア諸国での監視強化が実施されている。記事はRepublic of Koreaを発生地域として含めているが、サマリー本文ではSouth Koreaについて歴史的HFRS発生情報の文脈のみで、現在進行中のクラスター関連の実質的な被害地としては明記されていないため、対象国リストに該当する検証済み位置には含めていない。インドネシア、タイ、ベトナム、中国、インドは記事サマリーで明示的に現在の監視対象または曝露事例が述べられており含める。シンガポール(1880251)は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Phân biệt virus Hanta với cúm thường: Khi nào cần đi viện gấp?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Differentiating Hantavirus from seasonal influenza: When is urgent hospital care needed?
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak linked to the international cruise MV Hondius (2026) draws attention after illnesses in passengers who traveled through South America and the South Atlantic, with some fatalities and one confirmed positive case among evacuees. The Andes virus variant can spread between people only under very close, prolonged contact, but overall human-to-human transmission is limited. Hantavirus is rodent-borne, with infection mainly from encountering rodent urine, droppings, or saliva, or inhaling contaminated dust. Two severe syndromes exist: Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS) and Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS); HPS can progress rapidly. Incubation ranges 2–8 weeks; initial symptoms mimic flu (fever, headache, fatigue, myalgia, chills, GI upset) followed by cough, chest pain, dyspnea, hypotension, and potential respiratory failure. Distinguishing from influenza includes rodent exposure and longer incubation. No widely available vaccine; treatment is supportive. Vietnam reports no cases yet, but heightened surveillance; EU/ECDC deem community risk low, with ongoing monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスと季節性インフルエンザの区別：いつ緊急入院が必要か？
triage.triage_reason: 国際クルーズ船に関連するハンタウイルスアウトブレイク（死亡例・確定症例あり）で異常性と重症度が認識されるが、ベトナムでは未だ症例報告なく、対象国での現在の流行リスクは低い。続報注視が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはマルガルシティ（ニュージャージー州）とベトナムが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は南米と南大西洋を経由した国際クルーズ船のアウトブレイク。ベトナムは記事中で「まだ症例なし、監視を強化中」と記載されており、実際の流行発生地ではなく情報関心地として含めた。対象国リスト外の北米・南米での実際の流行はカバー外。IHR基準3項目該当だがWPRO対象国内での継続的流行エビデンスは限定的であるため、WATCH判定。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Jadi Sorotan, Dinkes Lebak Minta Warga Waspada Tikus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus Under Spotlight, Lebak Health Office Urges Residents to Watch Out for Rats.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-13, Lebak Regency has not reported hantavirus cases. Hantavirus remains a concern in Lebak, where authorities urge vigilance for rodent-borne transmission, especially via urine, saliva, and feces from rats. Transmission can affect the respiratory system and can cause acute kidney failure, with symptoms including high fever, chills, muscle pain, headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, weakness, and, in severe cases, cough, shortness of breath, hypotension, and kidney injury. The disease can affect anyone, not only adults. Officials emphasize that cleanliness and rodent-control at home and in surroundings are critical, and that protection should be used when cleaning potentially contaminated areas. While serious and potentially fatal if untreated, they advise against panic and stress prevention of transmission as the primary measure.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスが注目、レバク保健局が住民にネズミへの警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・レバク県でハンタウイルスに関する公衆衛生上の警告が発せられているが、実患者報告はなく、現在のところ具体的な流行の証拠がない。情報収集・経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは現在までにレバク県でのハンタウイルス確定患者の報告はない。保健当局による予防的啓発活動であり、実患者数が不明。ハンタウイルスは重症度が高く（急性腎不全、呼吸器症状、死亡リスク）、ネズミ媒介で複数人に影響する可能性があるため、スクリーニング基準を満たす。ただし現時点での具体的流行データがないため、WATCH（要経過観察）判定。

article.articleHeadline: കൊതുകുവല നിസാരക്കാരനല്ല; ഡെ​ങ്കിയിൽ നിന്നും രക്ഷനേടാം | Deepika | The Largest Read Malayalam Internet Daily | Online News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A mosquito bite is no small matter; protect yourself from dengue.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever, a viral disease transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes that breed in relatively clean water and bite mainly during the day, is described in Kerala health advisories. After a 3–14 day incubation, patients develop abrupt high fever, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgias/arthralgias, and a chest- or face‑rash with nausea or vomiting. Warning signs include persistent vomiting, abdominal pain, bleeding, dark stools, rapid breathing, pale or cold skin, fainting, or shock, requiring urgent hospital care. Older adults, infants under one year, and people with diabetes, hypertension, heart disease, cancer, or compromised immunity have higher risk of complications. There is no specific antiviral; treatment is supportive, with early diagnosis via available tests improving outcomes. Rest, hydration (salted rice water, coconut water, fruit juices), and avoiding aspirin or ibuprofen are advised; mosquito nets help prevent transmission. Information from Kerala State Health Department and Health Kerala.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊刺されは小さな問題ではない；デング熱から身を守ろう
triage.triage_reason: ケーラ州でのデング熱に関する公衆衛生情報記事。臨床的な警告サインと予防啓発が中心だが、現在の流行規模や死亡数などの具体的なイベント数値が不明であり、シグナル確定には情報不足。
triage.notes: 記事はケーラ州保健局による啓発記事で、デング熱の臨床特性と予防方法に焦点。蚊媒介性疾患であり長期的な感染リスク環境（Aedes蚊による繁殖地）が存在し、ヒト‐ヒト以外の感染経路を有する。ただし、具体的な患者数、死亡数、流行の規模や増加傾向などの定量的情報がないため、シグナル確定には続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cruise ship hantavirus outbreak rises to 11 cases as French passenger fights for life
article.articleSummary: As of 13 May 2026, hantavirus linked to the MV Hondius cruise has 11 reported cases, with 9 laboratory-confirmed and 3 deaths. A Spanish passenger tested positive in Madrid; authorities believe a Dutch couple who died were among the first exposed in South America before boarding. A French woman in Paris remains in critical condition, receiving extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO). The WHO says global risk remains low, though more cases could appear with the virus’s long incubation. Evacuation saw 87 passengers and 35 crew ashore in Tenerife, with others transferred to hospitals and quarantine facilities; the vessel heads back to Rotterdam for cleaning. Singapore reported two exposed residents who tested negative for Andes hantavirus and remain quarantined under a 30-day rule with 45-day monitoring. Southeast Asia has intensified screening (Malaysia; Indonesia), with Thailand, Vietnam and Cambodia monitoring. Hantaviruses are rodent-borne; HPS in the Americas, HFRS in Europe/Asia.

triage.headline_ja: クルーズ船のハンタウイルス感染アウトブレイク、フランス人乗客が危篤状態の中、11例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、複数国にまたがる確認患者と死亡例、国際的流行の可能性、WHO関与あり。フルRRA実施を推奨。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した地域にはスペイン、フランス、オランダが含まれているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。WPRO対象国内ではタイ、ベトナム、インドネシアが記事で言及されており、検査・監視の対象となっている。シンガポールも地理的に対象地域であるが対象国リストにないため除外。国際的流行の可能性が高く、長潜伏期間による継続的な症例出現リスク、かつ複数死亡例があるため PICKUP と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế thông tin về chủng virus Hanta đang được WHO cảnh báo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health informs about the Hantavirus strain that WHO is warning about.
